notes: fcs_ok/not_detected/fcs_failed/identity_rejects and the lock entries come from LOCK_STATS (target-lock scheduler counters).
final_* comes from FINAL: it includes acquire/candidate windows, so it is not target PRR and must not be quoted as such.
FINAL has no timing/sfd/payload counters; those come from the SUMMARY_* fail tokens (summary_timing_failed etc.).
frontend_scan_fraction can exceed 1 by <1%: frontend_us and frontend_scan_us take separate clock reads.
ABBA pairing: per block (A1,B1,B2,A2) pair 1 = (A1,B1) and pair 2 = (B2,A2); delta = suspend - scan.
runs are serial and ordered; wall_s is dominated by replay pacing, frontend_scan_us is the metric of interest.
